title: Mine Eyes Have Seen the Glory
lyrics: Mine eyes have seen the glory of the coming of the Lord;
He is [Eb]trampling out the vintage where the [Bb]grapes of wrath are stored;
He hath loosed the fateful lightning of his terrible swift sword;
His [Eb]truth is [F]marching [Bb]on.
[Bb]Glory, glory, hallelujah! [Eb]Glory, glory, [Bb]hallelujah!
[Bb]Glory, glory, hallelujah! His [Eb]truth is [F]marching [Bb]on.
Mine [A]eyes have seen the glory of the coming of the Lord
He is [D]trampling out the vintage where the [A]grapes of wrath are stored;
[E7]He hath [A]loosed the fateful lightning of His terrible swift sword;
[A7]His [Bm]truth is [A]marching on.
[A]Glory, glory, Hallelujah! [D]Glory, glory, [A]Hallelujah!
Glory, glory, [F#m]Hallelujah! [A7]His [Bm]truth is [A]marching on.
He has sounded forth the trumpet that shall never call retreat;
He is sifting out the hearts of men before His judgment seat;
O be swift, my soul, to answer Him! be jubilant, my feet!
Our God is marching on.
In the beauty of the lilies Christ was born across the sea,
With a glory in His bosom that transfigures you and me;
As He died to make men holy, let us live to make men free!
While God is marching on.
